Hi Neha / Samantha —

Thanks for the report. We investigated ticket COU-87932 and the 409 identity mismatch is typically triggered when the email domain used to register does not match any of the domains associated with the legal entity in our supplier verification database. Common fixes: 

- Upload required tax form (W-9) and COI in the portal; our verification job will re-run automatically within 2 hours.
- Provide a DUNS or company registration number to help us disambiguate the legal name.
- If the vendor uses a generic email that is not tied to the company domain (e.g., gmail), change to an AP contact using a company domain or provide an authorization letter.

Workaround: we can create a placeholder vendor record on your behalf if Redwood supplies a PVN (Partner Vendor Number) and the vendor's remit-to details. That allows PO issuance while verification completes. If you want that route, confirm Redwood contact and the vendor's remit-to address.

Ticket: https://support.coupa.com/tickets/COU-87932

Regards,
Coupa Support Team
